earningHelp: Points are earned when an order is completed, based on the actual food subtotal paid.
redemptionHelp: The discount applied when a customer uses their available points.
tiersHelp: Tiers use lifetime earned points, not the remaining balance.
memberHelp: The starting tier. Members can still earn and redeem points under the shared policy.
saveHint: Changes only take effect after a successful save.
positiveAmount: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000,000
percentRange: Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100
thresholdOrder: Gold must require more points than Silver
discountOrder: Gold must not offer a lower discount than Silver
title: Clucky Club settings
description: Shared policy for membership and checkout. Only admins can update it. Existing orders retain their locked policy version.
rules: Gold threshold must exceed Silver; Gold discount must not be lower. Apply vouchers, then tier discounts, then points. Exclude shipping. Earn on order completion and round down; redemption does not reduce tier progress.
